pr_title: [Feature][Refator] Decouple the allocation of SFA kv and indexer cache
source_quote:
what if this is the indexer layer without kvcache? It seems break the index cache?
The `self.use_sparse` is defined by `hf_config.index_topk`, thus it seems redundant to check `has_sfa_indexer_cache` here.
it's better to move this to `bind_kv_cache`
the `kv_caches` of `modelrunner` instance won't contain indexer cache, why do we need to filter the indexer cache out?
if self.use_sparse and current_sparse_c8:
kv_cache_raw_tensors[layer_name_inner] = (k_tensor,)
else:
assert v_tensor is not None
kv_cache_raw_tensors[layer_name_inner] = (k_tensor, v_tensor)
if self.use_sparse and current_sparse_c8:
v_cache = None
kv_caches[layer_name] = (k_cache,)
else:
assert raw_v_tensor is not None
v_cache = raw_v_tensor.view(v_cache_dtype).view(v_shape)
kv_caches[layer_name] = (k_cache, v_cache)
okay, thx for the details, it make sense to me then.

rule.description: 在 model runner 中处理 KV cache 时，sparse C8 场景下 SFA 层只有 k_cache（无 v_cache），需要用 `(k_cache,)` 单元素元组；非 sparse C8 场景则需要 `(k_cache, v_cache)` 双元素元组。同时应避免冗余的条件检查（如 `has_sfa_indexer_cache` 在 `self.use_sparse` 已确定时是多余的），以及不必要的 cache 过滤操作。
checkpoints: 检查 `kv_cache_raw_tensors` 和 `kv_caches` 的赋值是否遵循 sparse C8 的统一模式
确认是否存在冗余的 `has_sfa_indexer_cache` 检查（当 `self.use_sparse` 已确定时）
确认是否有不必要的 indexer cache 过滤操作
KV cache 绑定逻辑应放在 `bind_kv_cache` 方法中
